text:
Maya (AE): sharing the Kaleido POC redlines. procurement wants net45, KMS attestation, and a clause to wipe test data after project end. attaching redline PDF.
Nina - Legal: quick Q - is Kaleido storing any PHI or regulated data? also who will sign (Redwood US or Redwood EMEA)?
Maya (AE): not PHI, they process customer financial PII. signing entity is Redwood, US corp. procurement explicitly asked for HSM-level attestation in the MSA.
Omar (SE): FYI our Hosted product supports customer-managed keys but we can only provide HSM attestation if they run Dedicated with HSM KMS. For Hosted we can provide a procedural attestation but not a hardware cert.
Sam (Presales): option: offer a short Dedicated trial window for the POC. that meets attestation and gives predictable latency, but increases price.
Priya (Finance): net45 is acceptable for POC. need billing contact and PO before countersign. Kaleido asked invoices to be addressed to "Kaleido Corp AP" and wants first invoice after the trial month.
Nina - Legal: two main redline areas: 1) SLA — they want 99.99% and p95 inference latency <150ms for the POC 2) KMS indemnity and warranty language. they also added a subprocessor clause for embeddings vendor; need vendor list and data flow.
Maya (AE): SLA p95 150ms seems tight for Hosted. they are running moderate load.
Omar (SE): p95 150ms aligns with our Dedicated benchmarks. Hosted can do p50/burst but we cannot guarantee p95 at that threshold. recommend a fallback clause: commit to throughput baseline and route to Dedicated or compatible variant if latency breaches.
Nina - Legal: propose compromise language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet latency SLOs; if Customer requires a firm p95 latency SLA, parties will execute a Dedicated deployment addendum specifying the SLA and remedies." ok?
Maya (AE): good. procurement also wants signature routing: Procurement -> Legal (Kaleido) -> Exec sign at Redwood; they want countersign within 3 business days.
Priya (Finance): we can do e-signing and meet 3 business days if we receive PO and billing contact beforehand. finance requires PO before countersign for net45.
Nina - Legal: routing is fine. flagging that any ARR/commit >$150k needs VP commercial approval before Exec signs.
ContractsBot: ACTIONS SUMMARY:
- Legal (Nina) to draft MSA response with Dedicated addendum fallback and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- SE (Omar) to provide perf matrix and Dedicated trial cost estimate (ETA EOD).
- Sales (Maya) to obtain PO, billing contact, and signer names from Kaleido (ETA today).
- Finance (Priya) to confirm invoice flow and net45 on orderform (ETA EOD).
Sam (Presales): I'll prepare a one-pager Hosted vs Dedicated for the POC showing expected latencies, cost delta, and the HSM attestation differences.
Maya (AE): pinging Kaleido now for PO and signer list, cc @Sam to offer Dedicated trial. will update once I have PO.
Nina - Legal: :thumbsup: will escalate to Product Security if they push for hardware certs on Hosted.
Omar (SE): attaching sample order snippet for clarity:
```
OrderForm:
  Customer: Kaleido Corp
  POC duration: 3 months
  Billing: Net45
  PO required before countersign
  Deployment: Hosted default; Dedicated available via addendum
  KMS: customer-managed keys on Hosted (procedural attestation) or Dedicated HSM attestation
  SLAs: latency SLO; firm p95 SLA requires Dedicated addendum
  Sign flow: Procurement -> Legal (Customer) -> Redwood Exec
```
Maya (AE): everyone react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan.
Nina - Legal: :thumbsup:
Omar (SE): :thumbsup:
Priya (Finance): :thumbsup:
Sam (Presales): :thumbsup:
Maya (AE): thanks all — will post updates when PO and signer list come in.
